title: Austeridad
goal: Read how IMF-backed structural adjustment programs attached conditions -- spending cuts, devaluation, trade liberalization -- to emergency loans, and the sovereignty debate this sparked across the region.

items: Explain what governments turned to the IMF for.
List the typical conditions attached to these loans.
State what supporters of these policies argued.
State what critics of these policies denounced.
Use a cambio de to name what a deal requires or offers.
